name: Lost in the Shadows

angles.text: As a hunter, you need patience and careful stalking, not a reckless charge like a hungry raptor.
As a troll, you may recognize Pal'juh's eagerness to prove herself in the wilderness before she has mastered restraint.

faq.answer: Pal'juh is a promising young hunter who heads into danger alone. She has talent, but acts rashly and can be overwhelmed by beasts and the wilds.

aliases: what happened in lost in the shadows
lost in the shadows quest lore
faq.answer: Pal'juh went out alone and got into trouble again. Someone had to track her down and help her before she came to serious harm.
faq.q: What happens during the quest 'Lost in the Shadows'?

faq.answer: A raptor lunges without caution, while a tiger waits, stalks, and strikes with precision. The comparison warns that Pal'juh needs patience and discipline as a hunter.
faq.q: Why does the quest giver say Pal'juh acts more like a raptor than a tiger?

aliases: who turns in lost in the shadows
faq.answer: Someone who knows Pal'juh and expects her recklessness receives the report. They are relieved that help came to the headstrong tracker.
faq.q: Who receives the report for Lost in the Shadows?

faq.answer: Pal'juh survived because someone intervened. Her overseers remain watchful to see whether she learns the danger of wandering off alone.
faq.q: Does Pal'juh learn her lesson from this misadventure?

faq.answer: Pal'juh has raw talent and courage as a hunter. Her mentors warn that instinct cannot replace patience when tracking dangerous prey.
faq.q: Is Pal'juh considered a skilled hunter?

sections.body: Pal'juh went into hostile territory alone because she would not wait for help. A talented hunter, she soon found herself in over her head. Someone had to bring her safely back.
sections.title: A Reckless Scout

sections.body: After Pal'juh is rescued, her overseers see promise in her as a scout and tracker. Yet she charges like a raptor instead of stalking with a tiger's patience. The wilderness offers little mercy.
sections.title: Patience of the Hunt

summary: Pal'juh is lost in dangerous country after setting out alone. Her rescue shows why a hunter needs courage and patience.
attribution: In-game quest text: Lost in the Shadows
